endorsements.name: Miguel Xavier Penha Neto
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-2267
endorsements.description: The Mailchimp for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 2.7.1 has an AJAX action that allows any logged in users (such as subscriber) to perform a POST request on behalf of the server to the internal network/LAN, the body of the request is also appended to the response so it can be used to scan private network for example
endorsements.subtitle: CVE

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.
